SECTION_B0_FRESHNESS.hosted_mutations: NONE. No Vercel act, no Supabase act, no database connection, no deployment, no backup, no restore, no DDL, no environment-variable act, no scale change, no write lock, no credential generation.
SECTION_B0_FRESHNESS.live_control_plane_reads: NONE. This amendment, like v1.0.0, performed zero live management-plane reads. Its new external evidence is PUBLIC VENDOR DOCUMENTATION, fetched read-only and quoted with its URL, plus repository evidence. No document below is evidence about the live state of the governed project.

BASE_AUTHORITY.byte_unchanged: MANDATORY AND VERIFIED. This amendment does not edit v1.0.0. It supersedes named clauses by appending, exactly as the Recovery amendment v1.0.1 did to its own parent.

CERTIFICATION_CONSUMED.disposition: BOTH ACCEPTED IN FULL. Neither is editorial. Finding 1 invalidates the artifact's central adjudication; Finding 2 proves its proof primitive unsound. This amendment does not argue with either, does not preserve the substitution in any restated form, and does not retain the unsound primitive as a PASS contract anywhere.
CERTIFICATION_CONSUMED.self_criticism_recorded_once: v1.0.0's OF-Q2 nominated this exact adjudication as the right target for adversarial review. The certifier took that invitation and the answer was that the adjudication was wrong. The flag was correct; the adjudication it flagged was not.

the_parent_definition_verbatim.quoted_in_full: The execution lane MUST establish the no-intervening-mutation predicate POSITIVELY rather than assume it. Two postures are possible and the choice is an OWNER decision (OD-3): QUIESCE, in which the runtime is made non-writing for the window and that is evidenced; or ACCEPT, in which writes in the window are accepted as lost on restore and that acceptance is recorded in writing with a bounded rationale.
the_parent_definition_verbatim.the_operative_clause: QUIESCE, in which the runtime is made non-writing for the window and that is evidenced
the_parent_definition_verbatim.grammatical_reading: This is a CONJUNCTION of two limbs joined by 'and'. LIMB 1 is PREVENTION: the runtime IS MADE non-writing. LIMB 2 is EVIDENCE: that condition is evidenced. Limb 2 evidences limb 1. It does not replace it, and it is not satisfiable in limb 1's absence, because there would be no condition for it to evidence.

what_v1_0_0_did_wrong.the_substitution: v1.0.0's SECTION_D asserted that what OD-3 'actually requires is not that the writers be disabled' but only that the predicate be 'established POSITIVELY', and on that basis replaced LIMB 1 with a detection mechanism. It then argued the result was 'strictly inside QUIESCE'.
what_v1_0_0_did_wrong.why_it_is_wrong: The phrase 'established POSITIVELY' belongs to the SENTENCE BEFORE the definition and governs BOTH postures — it forbids assuming the predicate under either. It is not a definition of QUIESCE and it does not license dropping limb 1. The parent defines QUIESCE in the very next clause, and that definition contains the word 'made'.
what_v1_0_0_did_wrong.why_the_inside_QUIESCE_argument_fails: v1.0.0 argued that because detect-and-void never accepts a lost write, it is inside QUIESCE rather than beside it. That argument compares the mechanism only against ACCEPT. QUIESCE and ACCEPT are not the only two states of the world: a third state is A WINDOW THAT IS NEITHER PREVENTED NOR ACCEPTED, which is exactly what the parent's own fail_closed clause addresses — 'If neither posture is established, S8 is NOT satisfied.' Detect-and-void lands in that third state, not inside QUIESCE.
what_v1_0_0_did_wrong.the_honest_name_for_what_v1_0_0_proposed: A VERIFICATION-ONLY posture. It is a coherent engineering idea. It is not the posture the owner ratified, and naming it QUIESCE misrepresented it to the owner who would have to confirm it.

the_correction.rule: BINDING. Detection may be SUPPLEMENTAL EVIDENCE serving limb 2. It may NEVER be offered as, counted as, or named QUIESCE unless limb 1 — actual prevention — is independently satisfied and separately evidenced.
the_correction.consequence_for_this_artifact: Every clause of v1.0.0 that relies on the substitution is superseded by SECTION_B9. The adjudication of SECTION_D does not survive in any form.
the_correction.no_third_interpretation_is_created: This amendment does not propose a new reading of OD-3. It restores the parent's reading verbatim and measures whether it can be satisfied.

the_claim_that_was_false.v1_0_0_said: PostgreSQL assigns a transaction id only to a transaction that actually writes; read-only transactions never consume one. A pair of read-only observations of the database's transaction-id frontier, taken at the two boundaries of the window, therefore answers 'did ANYTHING write in this interval'.
the_claim_that_was_false.and_at_PQ_8_said: such a write advances the frontier and voids the window, which is the correct outcome.
the_claim_that_was_false.the_defect: The first sentence is true and the inference from it is INVALID. That a writing transaction is ASSIGNED an id does not entail that its COMMIT advances a scalar frontier.

construction: A write transaction is assigned a low XID, call it 100, and remains OPEN at W0.
Between W0 and W1, transactions with higher XIDs (101, 102, ...) start and complete, so the frontier has already advanced past 100 and then settles.
The low-XID transaction 100 COMMITS inside the window.
latestCompletedXid is only advanced by a committing transaction whose id EXCEEDS it. 100 does not exceed 102, so it does not move.
A scalar frontier read at W1 therefore equals the read at W0 for that quantity.
Yet a write committed after the recovery snapshot and before the DDL.
the_counterexample_ACCEPTED.classification: PROVEN FALSE NEGATIVE. The witness reports a clean window when a write committed in it. This is the one direction of error that v1.0.0 claimed was impossible.
the_counterexample_ACCEPTED.why_this_is_fatal_rather_than_a_caveat: v1.0.0's entire acceptance of the mechanism rested on the assertion that its error could only run toward false POSITIVES, i.e. fail-closed. A demonstrated false negative inverts that and makes the contract fail-open. A fail-open proof is worse than no proof, because it manufactures confidence.

the_disposition.scalar_frontier: REMOVED. No scalar transaction-id frontier is retained anywhere in this chain as a PASS contract, as a verdict input, or as evidence of absence of writes.
the_disposition.PQ_3: SUPERSEDED IN FULL. The equality PASS condition W1 == W0 is void.
the_disposition.PQ_4: SUPERSEDED IN FULL. See also SECTION_B10.CL-6 — its validation test could not have detected this defect.
the_disposition.PQ_8: ITS ASSERTION IS SUPERSEDED. The sentence asserting that an in-flight write 'advances the frontier and voids the window' is FALSE and is withdrawn. PQ-8's OTHER content — that a maintenance page is not proof, and that a request past a barrier completes normally — is TRUE, is not touched by this finding, and is PRESERVED.
the_disposition.M_11: SUPERSEDED IN FULL as a mechanism. It is re-entered in SECTION_B6 only as a REJECTED supplemental-witness candidate.

a_second_independent_unsoundness_found_b.finding: Even a witness with NO false negative on committed heap writes would still not prove absence of writes, because durable state advances without allocating a transaction id at all.
a_second_independent_unsoundness_found_b.measured: PostgreSQL 17 documentation, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-set-transaction.html, enumerates what a READ ONLY transaction disallows and then states verbatim: 'This is a high-level notion of read-only that does not prevent all writes to disk.' The enumeration contains INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, MERGE, COPY FROM, CREATE, ALTER, DROP, COMMENT, GRANT, REVOKE, TRUNCATE, EXPLAIN ANALYZE and EXECUTE. It contains NO sequence operation.
a_second_independent_unsoundness_found_b.consequence: See SECTION_B5. This is an independent ground for removing the primitive, and it survives even if the certifier's counterexample were somehow answered.

SECTION_B3_PREVENTION_MECHANISM_MATRIX.question: Is there any mechanism that genuinely MAKES the effective writer classes non-writing for the window, and evidences it?
SECTION_B3_PREVENTION_MECHANISM_MATRIX.method: Each candidate is assessed on the eight axes the lane brief names. UNKNOWN FAILS CLOSED. No candidate was executed; none may be.

standing_authority_fact.rule: APPLIES TO EVERY ROW BELOW AND IS DECISIVE ON ITS OWN.
standing_authority_fact.measured: PR #201's DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORIZATION_BOUNDARY.not_authorized contains verbatim 'ANY Supabase configuration mutation of any kind', 'ANY database DDL' and 'ANY database DML'. The Recovery authority's AUTHORIZED_OPERATIONS is conjunctive and exhaustive at AO-1..AO-9 and contains no configuration act, no role act and no ACL act. The owner-ratification record's explicit_non_authorizations states 'NO quiesce mechanism is authorized, named or pre-approved'.
standing_authority_fact.consequence: NO candidate below is held by current authority. Even a candidate that were technically sound would require a NEW grant. The technical assessment continues anyway, because the owner needs to know whether such a grant COULD work before being asked whether to issue one.

candidates.exact_privilege_needed: Ownership of the database, or a role with ALTER DATABASE on it. On managed Supabase the postgres role is not superuser; whether it may alter the database's GUC defaults is UNMEASURED by this lane.
candidates.exact_hosted_mutation: A privileged DDL-class statement on the live database.
candidates.existing_sessions_escape: YES. ALTER DATABASE ... SET takes effect for NEW sessions. Every session already connected at the moment of the change keeps its current value.
candidates.privileged_or_service_roles_override: YES, AND SO DOES EVERY OTHER ROLE. This is the decisive defect. default_transaction_read_only is a USERSET-class parameter: any client may turn it off for itself in one statement. Supabase's own documentation publishes the escape — see the MEASURED_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE below.
candidates.prevents_auth_storage_api_writes: NO in principle and NO in practice. GoTrue, PostgREST and Storage connect as their own roles and are unaffected by a default they can override; and where they do NOT override it, the effect is that the service ERRORS rather than that it is quiesced — see P-9.
candidates.rollback: Set it back. But the rollback is only as reliable as the forward act, and the forward act does not reach existing sessions.
candidates.evidence_contract: NONE AVAILABLE. A GUC that any session may override cannot evidence that no session overrode it, short of auditing every session — which is the original problem.

candidates.candidate: ALTER ROLE <each writer role> SET default_transaction_read_only = on.
candidates.repository_precedent_measured: This exact pattern already exists in this stack. db/baseline/stella_g2_roles.sql, blob 1867395de452084012e555ad39885669bc3b76ba, line 161 sets it for supabase_read_only_user and line 182 for uellix_auditor. Measured absence: the application role uellix_app has search_path, statement_timeout 30s and idle_in_transaction_session_timeout 60s configured at lines 174-176 and NO read-only default.
candidates.exact_privilege_needed: CREATEROLE with ADMIN on the target role, or superuser. For provider-managed roles such as supabase_auth_admin and authenticator, this is provider-owned territory.
candidates.privileged_or_service_roles_override: YES. Same USERSET defect. Additionally, a per-role setting is overridden by a per-database-per-role setting and by any explicit SET.
candidates.prevents_auth_storage_api_writes: NO. Reaching them means altering provider-managed roles, which breaks the services rather than quiescing them.
candidates.rollback: Reversible, with the same asymmetry as P-1.

candidates.candidate: The provider's own read-only mode, as a deliberately requested operator state.

MEASURED_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE.what_it_is: Supabase documents a read-only mode at https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/database-size: 'In some cases Supabase may put your database into read-only mode to prevent your database from exceeding the billing or disk limitations.' In that mode 'clients will encounter errors such as cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction.'
MEASURED_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE.how_it_is_implemented: By the same GUC as P-1. The documentation's own remedy is to run 'set default_transaction_read_only = off'.
MEASURED_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE.the_published_escape_hatch: The same page publishes a one-line per-session override: 'set session characteristics as transaction read write;'. The vendor therefore documents, as supported usage, precisely the act that defeats the control.
MEASURED_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE.the_decisive_control_plane_fact: The Supabase Management API exposes a readonly surface consisting of a status read and POST /v1/projects/{ref}/readonly/temporary-disable, documented at https://supabase.com/docs/reference/api/v1-disable-readonly-mode-temporarily as 'Disables project's readonly mode for the next 15 minutes'. THERE IS NO ENDPOINT TO ENABLE READ-ONLY MODE. The provider exposes read-only as an enforcement state it imposes on the project, and as something an operator may temporarily DISABLE. It is not an operator-initiable maintenance control.
MEASURED_PROVIDER_EVIDENCE.evidence_class: PUBLIC VENDOR DOCUMENTATION, read-only, quoted with URL. NOT a measurement of the governed project.

candidates.authority_holds_it: NOT APPLICABLE — the act does not exist to be held.
candidates.verdict: REJECTED. THE CONTROL DOES NOT EXIST IN THE REQUIRED DIRECTION. An operator cannot ask this provider to enter read-only mode; and if the project entered it by itself, the same documentation shows any client can step around it.

candidates.candidate: Terminate all sessions, e.g. pg_terminate_backend over pg_stat_activity.
candidates.existing_sessions_escape: Terminated sessions do not escape, but NOTHING PREVENTS IMMEDIATE RECONNECTION. Termination is an event, not a state. Absent a connection barrier it yields a gap of milliseconds.
candidates.prevents_auth_storage_api_writes: NO. GoTrue, PostgREST and Storage reconnect from their pools automatically.
candidates.backup_remains_possible: YES, but a termination sweep that included the backup's own session would abort the dump.
candidates.rollback: Not applicable; the act is not a state.
candidates.evidence_contract: A session list at one instant. It evidences nothing about the next instant.
candidates.verdict: REJECTED. AN EVENT, NOT A BARRIER. Sound only in combination with a connection barrier that this chain does not have.

candidates.candidate: Revoke CONNECT, or ALTER DATABASE ... WITH ALLOW_CONNECTIONS false.
candidates.exact_privilege_needed: Database ownership, or grantor rights on CONNECT.
candidates.existing_sessions_escape: YES. Neither act touches an established session.
candidates.privileged_or_service_roles_override: Roles with an explicit CONNECT grant are unaffected by a revoke from PUBLIC, and provider services hold their own grants.
candidates.prevents_auth_storage_api_writes: Only by breaking those services outright, which is P-9's objection.
candidates.backup_remains_possible: NO, if applied before the backup's connection is established; ALLOW_CONNECTIONS false also cannot be set on the database one is connected to.
candidates.verdict: REJECTED. Does not reach existing sessions, and interferes with the backup it exists to protect.

candidates.candidate: Revoke table-level and schema-level write privileges from the writer roles.
candidates.exact_privilege_needed: Ownership of every object, or superuser.
candidates.authority_holds_it: NO. It is also DDL, which two adjacent authorities forbid verbatim.
candidates.existing_sessions_escape: Privilege checks are re-evaluated per statement, so this DOES reach existing sessions for NEW statements — the only candidate in this matrix with that property.
candidates.in_flight_escape: A statement already executing, and a transaction already holding the rows it will write, are not stopped. See SECTION_B4.
candidates.privileged_or_service_roles_override: YES. Table owners and roles with BYPASSRLS or ownership are unaffected by REVOKE. supabase_admin-class roles retain access.
candidates.prevents_auth_storage_api_writes: Only by revoking from supabase_auth_admin and supabase_storage_admin, i.e. by breaking provider services.
candidates.rollback: A large, error-prone re-grant across every object. The rollback risk exceeds the act's benefit.
candidates.evidence_contract: A catalog diff could evidence the grant state. It could NOT evidence that no owner-privileged role wrote.
candidates.verdict: REJECTED. Unheld authority, does not bind owners, and a rollback whose failure mode is a silently broken staging environment.

candidates.does_not_prevent: W-4, W-5, W-6, W-7, W-16. GoTrue, PostgREST, Storage, Realtime and the dashboard reach the database from inside the platform and do not traverse the external restriction.

REJECTED, UNCHANGED FROM v1.0.0 AND ON THE SAME GROUND. A paused project cannot serve the logical backup, and cannot serve the DDL either. The mechanism destroys the acts it exists to make safe.

candidates.candidate: Accept service breakage as quiescence — let GoTrue, PostgREST and Storage fail their writes under a read-only default.
candidates.the_reasoning_tested: If a service cannot write, it is non-writing, so limb 1 is satisfied.
candidates.why_it_fails_on_the_evidence_limb: The failure is per-statement and client-visible. A GoTrue write that errors may be RETRIED by the client after the window, and the service's internal state may diverge from the database's. More decisively, a mechanism whose evidence is 'the service returned errors' cannot distinguish 'no write was attempted' from 'a write was attempted, errored, and will be replayed' — and it cannot evidence that NO statement slipped through before, between or after.
candidates.why_it_fails_on_the_prevention_limb: It rests on P-1 or P-2, which are advisory. A service that issues 'set session characteristics as transaction read write' — the vendor's own documented remedy — writes normally.
candidates.verdict: REJECTED. It is breakage, not quiescence, and it is still overridable.

matrix_result.coverage_of_the_effective_writer_set: 3 of 16 classes. The 13 remaining classes include three measured KNOWN_WRITERs that no candidate reaches at all — W-4 GoTrue, W-15 direct operator sessions, W-16 the dashboard SQL editor — and six UNKNOWN classes that fail closed.
matrix_result.conclusion: NO COMBINATION OF CANDIDATES SATISFIES LIMB 1 OVER THE EFFECTIVE WRITER SET, AND NO CANDIDATE THAT PARTIALLY SATISFIES IT CARRIES A SOUND EVIDENCE CONTRACT FOR LIMB 2 EXCEPT P-10.

SECTION_B4_IN_FLIGHT_TRANSACTION_ANALYSI.rule: A prevention mechanism is INCOMPLETE unless it proves that each class below is drained, terminated or voided BEFORE the recovery snapshot is taken.

classes.class: A write transaction already open before the quiesce act.
classes.reached_by: P-6 partially, for its NEXT statement only. No other candidate.
classes.residual: Rows it has already written are in its snapshot and will commit unless it is terminated. P-1, P-2, P-3, P-5 and P-7 do not touch it at all.
classes.bounded_by_anything_measured: PARTIALLY AND ONLY FOR ONE ROLE. db/baseline/stella_g2_roles.sql line 176 sets idle_in_transaction_session_timeout to 60s for uellix_app, so an IDLE-in-transaction session of that role is terminated after a minute. It does NOT bound a transaction that is actively executing, and it binds no other role.
classes.status: NOT DRAINED BY ANY AVAILABLE MECHANISM.

classes.measured: PostgreSQL 17 documentation, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/17/sql-prepare-transaction.html, states verbatim that after PREPARE TRANSACTION 'the transaction is no longer associated with the current session; instead, its state is fully stored on disk, and there is a very high probability that it can be committed successfully, even if a database crash occurs before the commit is requested', that COMMIT PREPARED or ROLLBACK PREPARED 'can be issued from any session, not only the one that executed the original transaction', and that 'the transaction continues to hold whatever locks it held'.
classes.consequence: A PREPARED TRANSACTION SURVIVES SESSION TERMINATION AND SERVER RESTART, AND MAY BE COMMITTED BY ANY SESSION AT ANY LATER TIME. P-4's termination sweep cannot drain it. A read-only default cannot stop its COMMIT PREPARED, because the write already happened at PREPARE time.
classes.status: NOT DRAINED BY ANY AVAILABLE MECHANISM. This is the single hardest in-flight class and it defeats the strongest candidate in the matrix.
classes.residual_measurement_gap: Whether max_prepared_transactions is non-zero on the governed project is UNMEASURED — MG-Q5. If it is zero, this class is empty. FAILS CLOSED until measured.

classes.class: A transaction that writes BEFORE W0 and commits AFTER W0.
classes.effect_on_the_recovery_point: Its write is NOT in the dump's snapshot, because the snapshot sees only transactions committed at snapshot time. It IS in the live database after it commits. Restoring the dump therefore loses it.
classes.why_v1_0_0_missed_it: This is precisely the certifier's counterexample, and PQ-8 asserted it would be caught.
classes.status: NOT PREVENTED AND, UNDER THE REMOVED PRIMITIVE, NOT DETECTED EITHER.

classes.class: A transaction that begins before the prevention act and commits during the window.
classes.status: Same as IF-1 and IF-3. Not reached by any advisory GUC, since its transaction_read_only was fixed at BEGIN from the then-current default.

classes.class: A transaction that writes BEFORE W1 and commits AFTER W1.
classes.why_it_matters: v1.0.0's window boundary was defined at the two observation instants. A transaction straddling W1 has its write inside the window and its commit outside it. Any boundary defined on COMMIT timing misclassifies it, and any boundary defined on WRITE timing cannot observe it.
classes.correction: The window boundary must be expressed on the DURABLE STATE of the recovery point, not on observation instants. v1.0.0's PQ-1 and PQ-2 anchored W0 correctly to the dump snapshot; PQ-2's anchoring of W1 to 'immediately before the first DDL statement' is preserved, but the claim that a pair of observations at those instants BOUNDS the set of in-window writes is withdrawn.
classes.status: RECORDED AS AN OPEN DEFECT OF ANY OBSERVATION-PAIR CONTRACT.

SECTION_B4_IN_FLIGHT_TRANSACTION_ANALYSI.conclusion: IF-1 through IF-5 are unaddressed by every candidate in SECTION_B3 except, vacuously, by P-10 — under which none of these transactions exists for W-1..W-3 because no runtime exists. For every other writer class they remain open. PREVENTION IS THEREFORE INCOMPLETE ON THE LANE BRIEF'S OWN TEST.

SECTION_B5_SEQUENCE_AND_SPECIAL_STATE.rule: BINDING. No claim of 'no writes' may be derived from transaction-id behaviour.

findings.measured: The PostgreSQL 17 SET TRANSACTION documentation enumerates the commands a READ ONLY transaction disallows and the enumeration contains NO sequence operation. The same paragraph states verbatim: 'This is a high-level notion of read-only that does not prevent all writes to disk.'
findings.consequence: nextval advances a sequence's durable state and emits WAL, and sequence advancement is NOT rolled back. It is therefore durable state change that (a) a fully-enforced read-only transaction does not prevent, and (b) an observer of transaction-id behaviour is not entitled to assume it would see.
findings.why_it_matters_for_a_restore: A restored dump carries the sequence values captured at snapshot time. Advancement during the window is lost on restore exactly as a row is, and can produce duplicate-key collisions after the restore rather than merely missing data.
findings.status: NOT COVERED BY ANY MECHANISM IN SECTION_B3 AND NOT OBSERVABLE BY THE REMOVED PRIMITIVE.

findings.state: Other write-like state not guaranteed to allocate the observed primitive.
enumerated_without_claiming_exhaustivene: Temporary-table writes, which the documentation's 'if the table they would write to is not a temporary table' qualifier expressly permits under READ ONLY.
Hint-bit setting and page dirtying caused by ordinary reads.
Autovacuum and anti-wraparound freezing, which write and may consume ids without user DML.
Cumulative statistics and any provider-side telemetry relation.
WAL emitted by checkpoints and background activity.
findings.classification: This list is ILLUSTRATIVE, NOT EXHAUSTIVE, and is recorded as such. An exhaustive enumeration of non-transactional durable state is not attempted, because an incomplete list presented as complete is how v1.0.0's primitive came to be trusted.
findings.consequence: The correct posture toward a witness is that it may CORROBORATE prevention and may never SUBSTITUTE for it.

findings.finding: Transaction ids are allocated cluster-wide, not per database. Activity in any other database of the same cluster moves the frontier without any write to the governed database.
findings.direction_of_error: FALSE POSITIVE. This one is fail-closed and was omitted from v1.0.0 rather than misstated.
findings.status: RECORDED. It does not rescue the primitive, because SECTION_B2's defect is a false NEGATIVE.

why_it_is_still_not_adopted: It cannot distinguish a COMMIT from an ABORT, so it can only ever yield a conservative VOID, never a clean PASS, for any transaction that was open at W0.
It does not observe SS-1 sequence advancement at all.
It remains subject to SS-3 cluster-global false positives.
Its privilege requirements and its exact semantics on the governed engine build are UNMEASURED by this lane — MG-Q3 remains open.

Most importantly: it is a DETECTION primitive, and SECTION_B1 forbids detection from standing in for prevention. Adopting it while limb 1 is unsatisfied would repeat v1.0.0's error in a better-instrumented form.

candidates.assessment: The LSN advances on checkpoints, autovacuum, hint bits and background activity, so it is overwhelmingly false-positive; and it is cluster-scoped, not database-scoped. It would observe SS-1 sequence advancement, which is its one advantage over SW-1 and SW-2.
candidates.privilege_note: Reading it requires privileges this lane has not measured, and on a managed provider its availability to a non-superuser role is UNMEASURED.

SECTION_B6_SUPPLEMENTAL_WITNESS_DISPOSIT.the_honest_statement_the_brief_asked_for: NO WITNESS AVAILABLE TO THIS CHAIN CAN PROVE TOTAL ABSENCE OF WRITES. SW-2 and SW-3 can, at best, prove that SOMETHING MAY HAVE HAPPENED — a conservative void signal. Neither can prove that nothing did. This lane states that plainly rather than selecting the least-bad primitive and describing it as a proof.

SECTION_B7_CAPABILITY_GAP.declaration: CAPABILITY GAP. No currently-authorized or control-plane mechanism can satisfy the ratified QUIESCE semantics — prevention AND evidence — over the effective writer set of the governed staging target.

the_three_independent_grounds.ground: AUTHORITY. Every candidate in SECTION_B3 except P-10 requires a Supabase configuration mutation, a database DDL/DML act, or a privileged role act. All three are forbidden verbatim by PR #201's not_authorized list, are absent from the Recovery authority's exhaustive AO-1..AO-9, and are expressly withheld by the owner-ratification record. This ground alone is dispositive and requires no technical argument.

TECHNICAL REACH. Even with unlimited authority, no documented control makes W-4 GoTrue non-writing. The only database-level read-only control is default_transaction_read_only, which the vendor's own documentation shows is overridable per session in one statement; and the vendor's Management API exposes read-only status and a temporary DISABLE, with no enable. W-15 and W-16 are likewise unreachable.

IN-FLIGHT COMPLETENESS. Even granting G-1 and G-2, IF-2 prepared transactions survive session termination and server restart and may be committed from any session at any later time. No candidate drains them, and whether the class is even non-empty on the governed project is unmeasured.

what_would_be_required_to_close_it: A hard, non-overridable read-only state. In PostgreSQL the only such state is hot-standby recovery, which managed Supabase does not expose as an operator control. UNMEASURED whether any equivalent exists — MG-Q4.
A provider-side control that stops GoTrue, PostgREST and Storage from writing while leaving the database reachable for pg_dump and for the DDL. No such control is documented.
A measured determination that max_prepared_transactions is zero, or a mechanism that drains prepared transactions — MG-Q5.
A new authority conferring Supabase-plane and database-plane mutation rights, which no artifact in this chain holds and which the owner has not been asked for.
SECTION_B7_CAPABILITY_GAP.what_is_NOT_claimed: It is NOT claimed that no such capability exists anywhere. P-12's search found none in public documentation, and absence of documentation is not a measurement. The gap is declared on what is HELD and what is PROVEN, which is the fail-closed posture.
SECTION_B7_CAPABILITY_GAP.consequence: IG-1 is NOT CLOSED and cannot be closed by authorship. Under the parent's own fail_closed clause — 'If neither posture is established, S8 is NOT satisfied' — S8 remains unsatisfiable under QUIESCE, and Stage-A remains blocked.

SECTION_B8_OWNER_READJUDICATION.status: ESCALATED TO THE OWNER. This is NOT a cost preference and is NOT presented as one. v1.0.0's OD-Q3 framed this choice as an operational-cost trade and that framing is SUPERSEDED. The question is whether a ratified posture can stand given that it has been measured unexecutable.
SECTION_B8_OWNER_READJUDICATION.question: Recovery OD-3 was ratified as QUIESCE. QUIESCE has now been measured to be unexecutable over the effective writer set, on three independent grounds. Does the owner KEEP QUIESCE, or CHANGE THE RECOVERY POSTURE?
SECTION_B8_OWNER_READJUDICATION.why_the_owner_and_not_the_author: The owner ratified OD-3. Only the owner may reopen it. An author who quietly reinterpreted it to something executable would be doing exactly what v1.0.0 did, and what the owner-ratification record's own reopening_rule exists to prevent.

options.statement: The owner maintains that staging writes must be PREVENTED for the window, at the all-writer scope, and that prevention must be evidenced.
measured_consequences: Stage-A stays BLOCKED for as long as the gap is open. S8 cannot be satisfied and no pre-DDL recovery point can be taken under a valid posture.
A NEW authority lane is required to confer Supabase-plane and database-plane mutation rights that no artifact in this chain holds, and the owner would be asked to grant them on a live target.

Even with those rights, G-2 measures that GoTrue cannot be provably prevented by any documented control. The lane would likely terminate in a PROVIDER capability request, whose outcome is outside the programme's control.
MG-Q4 and MG-Q5 must be closed first, each by its own read-only authority.
options.what_it_does_NOT_require: It does not require accepting any lost write. That is the whole point of keeping it.

options.statement: The owner reopens OD-3 and selects a different posture, or a different recovery model that does not need this predicate.

enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.option: Select ACCEPT, the parent's other ratified posture.
enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.consequence: Writes in the window are accepted as lost on restore, and the parent requires that acceptance to be recorded in writing with a bounded rationale and a stated exposure. The owner previously declined this explicitly: 'The owner does NOT accept intentional loss of writes in that window.' Selecting it now is a reversal and must be recorded as one.
enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.unblocks: S8 immediately, with no new authority and no hosted mutation.

enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.option: Narrow the QUIESCE scope to the PR #201-bound runtime only, i.e. reopen the SECTION_B scope adjudication in the owner's favour of option 1.
enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.consequence: P-10 alone then satisfies both limbs — genuine prevention by abstention, with a sound read-only evidence contract and zero hosted mutation. The residual exposure is that W-4, W-15, W-16 and six UNKNOWN classes may write in the window and be lost on restore, UNDETECTED. In substance this is a partial ACCEPT whose exposure has not been quantified, and it must be labelled as such rather than as a narrower QUIESCE.
enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.unblocks: S8, at the cost of an unquantified residual.
enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.authoring_note: This amendment does NOT take this route on its own initiative. SECTION_B of v1.0.0 adjudicated the all-writer scope on the parent's text and the lane brief directs that it be preserved. Only the owner may narrow it.

enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.option: Change the recovery model so the predicate is not needed — for example, make the window empty by construction by completing the backup and the DDL before any client of any kind exists against the governed project.
enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.consequence: This is the only sub-option that satisfies the SPIRIT of QUIESCE at full scope without new authority, and it is viable ONLY while PR #201 remains unexecuted. It requires MG-Q1 and MG-Q2 to be closed first, because 'no client exists' is currently UNKNOWN, not measured. If the census finds an exposed Auth surface with live sessions, C-3 collapses back into the gap.
enumerated_sub_options_with_consequences.unblocks: Potentially everything, contingent on a census this lane is not authorized to perform.

recommendation.primary: Close MG-Q1 and MG-Q2 under a narrow read-only census authority BEFORE answering. The census is cheap, mutates nothing, and determines whether C-3 is available — which is the only branch that preserves the owner's stated intent at full scope without new mutation authority.
recommendation.if_the_census_shows_no_live_writers: C-3, and QUIESCE stands as ratified.
recommendation.if_the_census_shows_live_provider_writer: The real choice is between KEEP QUIESCE with Stage-A blocked indefinitely, and C-1 ACCEPT with a quantified exposure. C-2 is not recommended, because it delivers an unquantified partial acceptance under a name that suggests prevention.
recommendation.what_is_NOT_recommended: Adopting any detection-only posture under the name QUIESCE. That is what this amendment exists to withdraw.

A test that only exercises the quiet case cannot certify a primitive whose defect lives in the busy case.
